verdict.rationale: Keyboard-driven operation is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions keyboard shortcuts or a command palette; the first-party docs cover only the Graph mail API. Community reports on speed are mixed: the web app loads in under a second and the Mac client feels native, but others say new Outlook is slow, unresponsive after network changes, and shows loading screens. None of this shows a keyboard-first interface.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
